module.label: Text -> Image
module.description: Krea 2 Turbo text-to-image. Install one base model, the shared text encoder and VAE, then add any optional LoRAs and upscalers you want.

groups.label: Krea 2 base model
groups.why: Install one of SNOFS_Krea2 or Krea2 Turbo Q5_K_M. Both load the same Krea 2 graph; the app uses whichever base file is present.

nodes.name: rgthree-comfy
nodes.why: Provides RgthreeDisplayAny, used by the optional ComfyUI prompt-enhancement workflow to return generated text through /history.

models.label: SNOFS_Krea2
models.name: snofsSexNudesAndOther_krea2TurboV14_int8.safetensors
models.why: Reference Krea 2 int8 base. Civitai may require login and NSFW opt-in; the file may be named without the `_int8` suffix.

models.label: Krea2 Turbo Q5_K_M
models.name: krea2_turbo-Q5_K_M.gguf
models.why: Smaller GGUF alternative. Requires the core ComfyUI-GGUF node.

models.label: Qwen3-VL 4B text encoder
models.name: qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors
models.why: Shared CLIP/text-encoder file loaded with clip type `krea2`.

models.label: qwen_image VAE
models.name: qwen_image_vae.safetensors
models.why: Shared Krea 2 VAE used for both base models.

models.label: 4x-UltraSharp
models.name: 4x-UltraSharp.pth
models.why: Optional ESRGAN post-pass. It is an alternative to latent refine, not a required file.
